description: This file defines the MakeValue class, which implements an entity operation for the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It processes the <make-value> element, creating and populating a {@link GenericValue} based on provided parameters such as entity name and a map of values, within the context of a mini-language method execution.

classes.name: MakeValue
classes.description: Implements an entity operation for creating a generic value within the MiniLang framework, based on XML configuration.

methods.name: MakeValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MakeValue instance by parsing configuration attributes from the XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the make-value operation: expands the entity name, retrieves the delegator, creates a valid GenericValue, and stores it in the environment map.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact info, adding the entity name used in the operation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the make-value element with its attributes.
